basis: Phase3 modifies whole content based on accumulated Phase2 observations, not one-by-one convergence patches.

budget_gate.reason: Planning from completed S1-S7 rollup; no implementation/application and no new cross-agent ambiguity.

non_convergence_guard: Do not apply any single revision directly from one observation. Apply only after grouped plan review; keep each change tied to whole-flow stage and acceptance test.

observed_gap.description: The Phase3 plan is now structured, but applying it would be a separate authorization lane. This plan must stay HOLD evidence until the user approves implementation/revision application.

purpose: Turn S1-S7 Phase2 function-test observations into a grouped Phase3 revision plan without applying changes yet.

revision_plan_items.acceptance_test: A future output/card must be understandable from the surface and still point to deeper packet evidence.
revision_plan_items.planned_change: Define one compact minimal_space_delta line for merge outputs, role reviews, and operator surfaces so future reentry does not lose packet-level evidence.

revision_plan_items.acceptance_test: A short continuation is classified by actual latest next-lane card, not guessed from model memory.
revision_plan_items.planned_change: For continuation-only user inputs, require latest next-lane lookup before intent classification.

revision_plan_items.acceptance_test: Selected refs include changed_judgment; rejected refs include reason and are not silently reintroduced.
revision_plan_items.planned_change: Add rejected refs with reason to source-selection surfaces when rejected refs materially prevent archaeology/decorative citation.

revision_plan_items.acceptance_test: Codex and Gemini outputs can be compared without forcing artificial separation or accepting pure duplication.
revision_plan_items.planned_change: Record each agent’s unique delta and classify overlap as productive/duplicative.

revision_plan_items.acceptance_test: Explicit exclusion phrases such as not validator/checklist hardening do not fail unless target actually is validator hardening.
revision_plan_items.planned_change: Keep as watch unless validator false positives recur in Phase3 plan tests; then distinguish exclusion wording from target classification.

space_reference_delta.changed_judgment: This turn is a plan lane only; implementation/source/schema/authority changes remain forbidden.
Phase2 S1-S7 is complete enough to prepare Phase3 planning, not to apply fixes.
Patterns must be grouped into must/should/watch priorities instead of patched one by one.
Phase3 revision must use whole-flow stage placement as the organizing frame.

space_references_used.used_for: declares Phase3 plan lane and no-apply rules
root summary of S1-S7 completion and pattern IDs
detailed function-test rollup and observed gaps
user principle: Phase3 revises from accumulated Phase2 observations
